name: command-menu
description: Renderless ⌘K command palette + generic search modal pulled UP from notion-page-clone's command-palette portable surface. Consumer supplies groups + onSelect + bindings; slice owns dialog chrome, ⌘K hotkey, MRU history.
notes: Renderless API. CommandPalette accepts `groups: CommandGroup[]` + `onHistorySelect` + `labels`. SearchModal accepts `bindings: SearchModalBindings` + `labels`. Nosion-specific adapters from upstream notion-page-clone were dropped — see README for adapter patterns.
